sign_in.brand.tagline: Every page read. Every fact traced.
sign_in.brand.point_pages: Sorted and numbered. Nothing thrown away.
sign_in.brand.point_facts: Every fact linked to the exact words in the records.
sign_in.brand.point_visits: See each visit as it was seen on the day.
sign_in.brand.point_court: Walk into court with page numbers that match.

sign_in.password.title: Welcome back
sign_in.password.intro: Sign in to carry on where you left off.
sign_in.error.credentials: That email and password don't match. Please try again.
sign_in.error.invalid: Please check the email address and password.
sign_in.code.title: Enter your code
sign_in.code.intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and type the 6-digit code it shows.
sign_in.enrol.title: Set up the code on your phone
sign_in.enrol.intro: Each time you sign in, we'll ask for a 6-digit code from your phone. It keeps the records safe.
sign_in.enrol.step_app: Open an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
sign_in.enrol.step_scan: Scan this picture with the app.
sign_in.enrol.step_code: Type the 6-digit code the app shows.
sign_in.enrol.qr_alt: Picture to scan with your authenticator app
sign_in.enrol.key: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app instead:
sign_in.codes.title: Your backup codes
sign_in.codes.intro: If you lose your phone, you can sign in with one of these codes. Each works once. Write them down or print them, and keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
sign_in.recover.title: Use a backup code
sign_in.recover.intro: Lost your phone? Sign in with one of your backup codes, then set up the code on your new phone.
sign_in.forgot_form.title: Reset your password
sign_in.forgot_form.intro: Type your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
sign_in.forgot_form.sent: If that address has an Avodeck account, we've sent a link to it. The link works for one hour.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: Use at least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. For your safety, we've signed you out everywhere.
reset.no_token: This link is not complete. Please open it again from the email.
choose_password.title: Choose your own password
choose_password.intro: You signed in with a temporary password from Avodeck support. Choose your own now. You will use it from now on.
choose_password.wrong: That is not the password you were given. Check it and try again.
choose_password.same: Your new password must be different from the one you were given.
choose_password.weak: This password is too easy to guess. Please choose a longer one.
email_confirm.title: Your email address
email_confirm.waiting: Thank you. Now open the link we sent to your other address.
email_confirm.changed: Your email address has been changed.

cases.title: Your cases
cases.intro: Every case you work on, in one list. Click a case to see its papers and where you are.
cases.empty.title: No cases yet
cases.empty.intro: Every case you work on will be listed here.
cases.empty.body: When you're asked to help with a case, start it here. You'll need the letter asking you to help and the medical records.
cases.empty.papers.title: Add papers in any order
cases.empty.papers.body: We number every page and sort the records by date for you.
cases.empty.safe.title: Kept safe in the UK
cases.empty.safe.body: Records are stored privately and only you, and people you add, can open them.
cases.empty.team.title: Working with a team?
cases.empty.team.body: If an organisation sends you cases, ask them to add you. Their cases appear here too.
today.first.title: Welcome to Avodeck, {{name}}
today.first.intro: You don't have any cases yet. Three short steps and you're ready for your first one.
today.first.account.title: Set up your account
today.first.account.body: Your password and the code from your phone keep the records safe.
today.first.profile.title: Fill in your expert profile
today.first.profile.body: Your qualifications, where you've worked and your training. You do this once.
today.first.signature.title: Add your signature
today.first.signature.body: Draw it with your mouse or upload a photo. It goes on every report you sign.
today.first.can_start: You can start a case before you finish these.
today.first.hand.title: Have these to hand
today.first.hand.letter.title: The letter asking you to help
today.first.hand.letter.body: We read the questions you've been asked from it.
today.first.hand.records.title: The medical records
today.first.hand.records.body: As PDFs, in any order. One file or many.
today.first.hand.date.title: The date your report is due
today.first.hand.date.body: We'll remind you as it gets close.
today.first.help.title: Need a hand?
today.first.help.body: Our team can walk you through your first case. Send us a message and we will go through it together.
today.first.how.title: How a case works
today.first.how.intro: Every case goes through the same five steps. You stay in charge at each one.
today.first.how.1.title: Prepare
today.first.how.1.body: Add the letter and the records. We number every page and sort them by date.
today.first.how.2.title: Read
today.first.how.2.body: You read every page. We point out dates, results and letters, and you check each one.
today.first.how.3.title: Understand
today.first.how.3.body: See the whole story on one timeline, and the things worth a closer look.
today.first.how.4.title: Write
today.first.how.4.body: Write your opinion in your own words. Every fact links back to its page.
today.first.how.5.title: Take it forward
today.first.how.5.body: Answer questions, meet the other expert and take your pages into court.
today.first.never.body: It finds and links the facts. What you conclude, and how you say it, is always yours.
account.title: Account and security
account.intro: One sign-in for all your work, in your own practice and in any team.
account.sign_in.note: Changing your email needs a click from both your old and new address. No one else, including a team admin, can reset your code for you.
account.sign_in.title: Signing in
account.email.label: Email
account.orgs.title: Your organisations
account.backup.keep: Keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone.
account.email.sent: We've sent a link to your old and new addresses. Open both links to finish.
account.password.label: Password
account.password.sent: We've sent you a link to choose a new password.
account.code.always_on: Always on. It keeps the records safe.
account.backup.title: Backup codes
account.backup.intro: For when you lose your phone.
